fields.name: Preferred Agents Justification
fields.question: Identify why the preferred agents cannot be used:
fields.context: Explanation for not using preferred preventive or acute migraine treatments.
fields.answer: Patient has a longstanding history of chronic migraines, experiencing more than 15 headache days per month. She has tried numerous preventive medications including Propranolol, Verapamil, Topiramate (Topamax), Nortriptyline, Venlafaxine (Effexor), Gabapentin, and Botox. She has also used Aimovig, but has been off it since December due to insufficient relief or other reasons. Acute treatments tried include Zomig, Frova, Imitrex, Fioricet, Zofran, Naproxen, and Medrol Dosepack. Despite these interventions, she reports continued chronic daily headaches and prefers to try Vyepti over continuing Botox for prevention.
